#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="${1:-${DEST:-}}"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup destination is not set." >&2
    echo "Usage: $0 [user@]host:/path | /path/to/backup-dir" >&2
    echo "Alternatively set the DEST environment variable." >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "backed up $BUNDLE to $DEST"

arguments.command: chmod +x backup.sh && rm -f logs-*.tar.gz && tmpdest=$(mktemp -d) && ./backup.sh "$tmpdest" && ls -la "$tmpdest" && tar -tzf "$tmpdest"/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz && rm -rf "$tmpdest" logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz
